The '''Highport Banking Tower''' was a building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. During the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Taris Siege|occupation]] of Taris, a [[Gorrga|Mandalorian]] left a [[Davaab-type starfighter|''Davaab''-type starfighter]] on the top of the building. It was later pushed over the side of the tower to make way for a receiver platform.<ref name="Interference">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/interference20090929.html|text="Interference"|int=Interference|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>
